_about: The 1.5 issue list (SongSpec_1.5_instructions_and_things_that_need_fixed.docx, 2026-11-15): the tracker's values for 26 songs the app got wrong or right. bpm: the tracker's BPM per section in order ('*' songs = 6/8 eighth-note tempo; 12/8 songs = twice the dotted-quarter tempo, e.g. Feel The Fiyaaaah 118.666 = 178 at 6/8). keys: the tracker's key field per section. sig: time signature per section. Audio: C:/dev/detunetest/testdata/v15/<key>.m4a (yt-dlp search results, not in git).

earned_it.notes: outro is D Dorian; app said 3/4

sorry_not_sorry.song: Tyler, The Creator - SORRY NOT SORRY
sorry_not_sorry.notes: pitched up 0.15 semitones; could be seen as F# Minor; works with 4/4; BPM may be slightly inconsistent; app said 4/4 ~130

changes.notes: 2:55-4:01 in 6/8 (137 on a 6/8 time signature); C Major part works with D Minor (arguably D Dorian)
